title: Sprint 5: Import and academic review
bullets: Import a lesson package, check it, review it, approve it
Prompt specification for ChatGPT, used manually
narration: Sprint five. Import and academic review. Content made with ChatGPT is imported as a package, checked, reviewed, and approved before any video is requested.

title: Import and validation
bullets: A ZIP, or lesson.csv with an optional lesson_plan.json
The five canonical columns are kept exactly; the original CSV is stored untouched
Clear errors with row numbers; nothing is imported when there are errors
Unsafe archive paths, links, oversized files and wrong encodings are rejected
narration: A ZIP, or a C S V with an optional lesson plan, can be imported. The five canonical columns are kept exactly, and the original file is stored untouched. Errors name the row and the problem, and nothing is imported when there are errors. Unsafe archive paths, links, oversized files and wrong encodings are rejected.

title: Academic review
bullets: Draft, in review, changes required, approved, rejected
Reviewers need a note to request changes or reject
Approval is separate from video completion
narration: Each language version moves through draft, in review, changes required, approved, and rejected. Requesting changes or rejecting needs a note. Importing new content cancels an earlier approval. Approval stays separate from video completion.

title: Prompt specification
bullets: Built from the lesson: class, subject, chapter, topic, language, duration
Asks for exactly the CSV columns and JSON this app imports
Copied by a person into ChatGPT, nothing is automated
narration: The app builds a prompt from the lesson details, language and duration. It asks for exactly the columns this app imports. A person copies it into ChatGPT. Nothing is automated.

title: Test results
bullets: 38 cover validation and review rules, plus a migration test on a populated database
Frontend builds; import and review checked in the browser
Next: connect approved lessons to the Video Engine
narration: Sixty six backend tests pass. They cover validation, the review rules, tenant isolation, and a migration on a database that already has data. That test caught a real migration problem, which is fixed. Next is sprint six, connecting approved lessons to the Video Engine.
